title: LexiLoop
features: User registration (email + password) and learner profile
Onboarding: pick English level and daily goal
Learn new words with word cards (meaning, example, pronunciation tap)
Short exercises: multiple-choice quiz with instant feedback
Lesson complete summary with XP and streak
Saved word list with mastery status
Progress tracking: streak, XP per day chart, words learned, level progress
Basic animations and smooth screen transitions
REST API client to a Node.js backend (mocked locally), offline word cache

bottomTabBar.note: Flat white bar, 1px top border, 4 tabs in this exact order. Active tab: icon + label in accentFill #007F9B with a small pill indicator behind the icon in accentTint; inactive: text.secondary.

sharedComponents.statusBar: Top header row: screen title left in display font, streak chip right (flame icon + '12' on accentTint).
sharedComponents.controls: Primary button: pill, 56px tall, accentFill #007F9B with white label (pressed darker, disabled 40% opacity). Secondary button: pill, white with 1.5px borderStrong border, ink label. Text input: 12px radius, 52px tall, white, borderStrong border, focus = 2px accentFill ring, error = danger border + 13px helper. Card: white, 20px radius, soft shadow. Chip: pill, 32px tall, accentTint fill with accentFill text, 13px label. Quiz option: 16px radius white card with 1.5px border; selected-correct = success tint + check icon, wrong = danger tint + x icon.

screens.name: welcome
screens.purpose: First launch: brand promise and entry to sign up or log in

screens.content: Step indicator 2 of 2; title 'What is your English level?'; 3 selectable cards Beginner (A1-A2), Intermediate (B1-B2, selected), Advanced (C1); section 'Daily goal' with chips 5 words / 10 words (selected) / 15 words; primary 'Start learning'

screens.name: home-empty

screens.content: Greeting 'Welcome, Maya'; real photo of an open notebook and a cup of tea on a desk; title 'Your first lesson is ready'; body 'Learn 10 everyday words in about 5 minutes'; primary 'Start lesson 1'; streak chip 0 days

screens.purpose: Celebrate the finished lesson with XP and streak
screens.content: FOCAL large '+80 XP' numeral on gradient circle; title 'Lesson complete!'; stats row: 10 words, 90% accuracy, 4 min; streak chip '13 day streak'; list of 3 new words learned (commute, reliable, itinerary) with check marks; primary 'Back to home'; secondary 'Review mistakes'

screens.name: progress
